_README: This file is the second half of the Phase 6 model-card completeness gate. The first
half is registry rule R1, which the card schema enforces at registration: a parameter
whose source is `todo-calibrate` must carry a calibration *plan*, or the model cannot
be registered at all. A plan is a sentence an implementer wrote. This file records
which of those plans somebody has TAKEN ON: an id, an owner, a state, and the
`issues` IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE TRUE STATE OF THE PROJECT, NOT A PLACEHOLDER.
Nobody has been assigned a calibration measurement. The gate therefore fails on every
uncalibrated high-tier default in the registry, and `docs/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md` carries
the number. Writing issues into this file with no owner behind them would turn the gate
green without a single measurement being made, which is the exact failure the gate
exists to prevent; `_example` below shows the shape without being read as data.
The gate is implemented in `crates/v2xw-metrics/src/gate.rs` and run by
grammar and for how to open an issue.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored by the parser; this block and `_example`

_example.title: Cohda MK5 SXF1700 sign and verify throughput are not published
_example.owner: name of the person who will bench the device
_example.measurement: Bench an MK5 through the Cohda SDK security API: 10,000 back-to-back sign and verify calls, report the median and the 95th percentile service time and the observed queue depth. Until then the profile's service time is 1/throughput from a flagged SAF5400 proxy.
